{{Quote|First time's a bit of a shocker, eh?... Sorry to cut you short, but the old tub's hyperspace warning came on a moment ago. Better come back in. It's a long ride to the nearest planetary base"|Margoet|<ref name="TIE Fighter Guide">''[[TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''''Margoet''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] who informed [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] that the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|"Imperial"-class Star Destroyer]] "[[Vengeance II|Vengeance]]" had began procedures to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] and advised him to return to the ship.
